name: Internet Gambling Sites Poker Odds Calculator
author: ailene999

sections.description:
Internet Gambling Sites Poker Odds Calculator lets you compare your Texas Hold’em hand against an opponent’s hand (or a random hand) and any board cards. It runs a Monte Carlo simulation directly in the visitor’s browser and shows win, tie and lose percentages.

  • Use the shortcode [igamblingsitespoker] on any page or post.
  • Pick your hole cards, optionally lock in an opponent’s cards, and optionally set some or all board cards.
  • See equity percentages from a 15,000 hand simulation.
  • Responsive design and dark-mode support.

For more gambling tools and reviews visit https://internetgamblingsites.net/

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/internet-gamblingsites-poker-odds-calculator/ or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Add [igamblingsitespoker] to any post or page.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Texas Hold’em equity calculator with shortcode.
  • Hand evaluator corrected to weight hand categories (pair, straight, flush, etc.) above kickers.
